title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - SubsidiaryLocation
description: Subsidiary location (era:SubsidiaryLocation's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Subsidiary location must be linked to a Primary Location and specifies in more detailed way part, attributes, or usage of Primary location. It may be also a non-rail point or a rail point that is not managed by an Infrastructure Manager (IM). It may be defined by entity having company code according to their needs. The Subsidiary location is optional and dependent upon business needs. Inherits attributes from era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SubsidiaryLocation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

allocationCompany.description: Relationship. The organisation in charge to allocate the code for the subsidiary location.

linkedToPrimaryLocation.description: Relationship. Relates a subsidiary location with a primary location.

subsidiaryLocationCode.description: Property. The numeric code for the subsidiary location

subsidiaryLocationName.description: Property. The common name given to the subsidiary location

subsidiaryLocationType.description: Property. Indicates the subsidiary location type that belongs to a taxonomy. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Subsidiary location types' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/subsidiary-location-types/SubsidiaryLocationTypes), 37 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

validity.description: Relationship. Relates a feature with a temporal feature to indicate a validity period. Target type (TemporalFeature) is not published as its own SDM model in this RINF pass.
